title: ConQUESTA: Topology-Aware Post-Training Structural Pruning of Quantum Neural Networks
summary: Deploying quantum neural networks (QNNs) on sparse hardware requires preserving task accuracy while reducing compiler-induced two-qubit gates, SWAPs, and depth. We present ConQUESTA (\underline{C}onstrained \underline{Qu}antum \underline{E}ntangler \underline{S}election with \underline{T}opology \underline{A}wareness), a post training pruning framework that combines task saliency with compiler cost, screens candidate entanglers, and searches complete pruning masks under an explicit accuracy constraint.
